While the résumé reflects a single employer, the depth of responsibility taken on suggests a rapid internal promotion trajectory, moving from a contributor role to a de‑facto technical lead on the front‑end product line.

Your rapid rise and focus on accessibility are strong differentiators. To broaden your impact toward full‑stack senior roles, consider deepening your experience with back‑end languages (Python or Node), API design, and cloud platforms such as AWS or Docker.
